_comment: Per-account recoverable labor cost. annual = agents * (idle_minutes_per_agent_hour / 60) * productive_hours_per_year * loaded_hourly_cost. Conservative defaults; tune with real numbers.
_verified_note: Set _verified true ONLY when these three inputs are replaced with figures confirmed in the Intradiem Value Repository. Until then every dollar this model produces is a placeholder assumption, not an Intradiem-verified number, and impact_engine stamps the surfaced total UNVERIFIED. Never let a figure derived from these defaults reach prospect-facing copy or a leadership readout as though it were verified. Added 2026-08-07.
